entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One adult male Long Evans rat, identified by a five-digit animal id. The data descriptor lists nine rats.

entityTypes.name: session
entityTypes.description: One recording session in one NWB file: unit spike times from Neuropixels probes in LEC, MEC and/or CA1, position, head direction, speed and task epochs. Which tasks a file holds is listed in docs/index.json.

session_id.name: session_id
session_id.title: Session
session_id.description: The <session-date_time> part of the file name, yyyy-MMM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

session_date.name: session_date
session_date.title: Session date
session_date.description: The date part of the file name, e.g. 2020-Nov-04. It uses an English month abbreviation (LDML MMM), which is not in the portable format subset, so it is kept as text.

session_time.name: session_time
session_time.title: Session start time
session_time.description: The HH-mm-ss part of the file name.

dataLocations.description: Kanter et al., electrophysiological recordings from entorhinal cortex and hippocampus in freely behaving adult male rats (dataset version 885b4936-9345-43bd-880e-eebc19898ded). The data descriptor: '/data/<subject_id>/<subject_id>_<session-date_time>.nwb [main data files]', with scripts/nwb.py, scripts/requirements.txt, docs/index.json (session and task index), the data descriptor and the licence. Units are spike-sorted with KiloSort 2.5. Every entry of the bucket was listed.
